clue.text: Plan curtailed in racing establishment to get piece of furniture

indicators.note: the shortened plan sits inside the racing establishment

parts.note: a stable is where racehorses are kept and trained

indicators.note: curtailed means cut short, so the last letter of the synonym goes

parts.note: a plan is an idea

explanation.surface: Someone's scheme is cut back at a racing yard so they can buy furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plan' looks like part of the surface's scheme, but it is the word cut short by 'curtailed', then held 'in' the yard.
explanation.definitionFit: A side table is an item of furniture placed against a wall or beside a chair.

clue.text: Quick route taken by lazy barber?

definitions.meaning: a quicker path than the usual way
a lazy barber gives a brief haircut, a cut that is short

explanation.surface: A barber who can't be bothered takes the easy way.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both a faster route and, humorously, a haircut left short.

clue.text: Elegant socialite broadcasting

parts.note: a deb, short for debutante, is a young society woman
a programme being broadcast is on air

explanation.surface: A fashionable society figure appears on radio or television.
explanation.definitionFit: Debonair is a synonym of suave and stylish.

clue.text: A steer solved puzzle

indicators.note: solved suggests working the letters out into a new order

explanation.surface: A bullock has cracked a riddle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'solved' rearranges the six letters of A STEER.
explanation.definitionFit: A teaser is a brainteaser, a tricky problem.

clue.text: Fellow with minister in Cornish town

parts.note: bod is British slang for a person or chap

explanation.surface: A man arrives with a clergyman in a Cornwall town.
explanation.walkthrough: BODMIN is a town in Cornwall, the county at England's south-western tip.
explanation.definitionFit: Bodmin is a historic market town in Cornwall, England.

clue.text: Chaps heading off with trainer? Right to go inside and intrude

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is removed

parts.note: chaps are men

indicators.note: the letter for right enters the trainer word

parts.note: a coach trains athletes

explanation.surface: Men leave as a coach claims the right to enter and interfere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' and 'to go inside' are separate instructions; 'with' simply joins the two parts.
explanation.definitionFit: To encroach is to trespass or advance gradually beyond proper limits.

clue.text: See copper beginning to mismanage deputy

parts.note: lo is an old word for look or see
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the next word is taken

explanation.surface: A policeman starts to botch things while standing in for someone.
explanation.definitionFit: A locum is a stand-in, especially a doctor or cleric covering for another.

clue.text: Bet concerning idle figure

parts.note: to lay a bet is to wager
about means regarding or concerning

explanation.surface: A wager is made regarding someone who does nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A layabout is a lazy, idle person who avoids work.

clue.text: Where one goes for screening?

parts.note: screening suggests a medical check, but here it means a film being shown

explanation.surface: Asks where you would go to be screened, as for a health check.
explanation.definitionFit: Films are screened in a picture house, so that is where one goes for screenings.

clue.text: Strong fighter with hit I missed on unknown

parts.note: a MiG is a Russian fighter jet

indicators.note: the letter I is left out of the word

parts.note: Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A boxer takes a hit but misses with a blow to an unknown opponent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fighter' suggests a boxer, but it is the Soviet jet; 'missed' acts on 'hit', and 'on' places the unknown after.
explanation.definitionFit: Mighty is a synonym of powerful or strong.

clue.text: In plane like a powerful business type?

definitions.meaning: a company director sits on the board

explanation.surface: Describes a senior executive flying somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means aboard a vehicle and, as a director, a member of the governing board.

clue.text: Very thin person in swamp in African city

indicators.note: the thin person is placed inside the swamp

parts.note: a marsh is a swamp
a rake is a very thin person

explanation.surface: A skinny figure is stuck in a bog in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Marrakesh is a major city in Morocco, North Africa.

clue.text: Greek in series of shops showing annoyance

indicators.note: the Greek abbreviation goes inside the shops word

parts.note: a chain is a group of shops under one owner

explanation.surface: A Greek man in a high-street chain looks irritated.
explanation.definitionFit: Chagrin is vexation or mortification at being let down.

clue.text: Loan Amy squandered? Something irregular

indicators.note: squandered suggests the letters are thrown away and scattered

explanation.surface: Amy wasted a loan, which was out of character.
explanation.definitionFit: An anomaly is something that deviates from what is normal.

clue.text: Give up a venture and surrender after trading blows?

definitions.meaning: a boxer's corner tosses a cloth into the ring to concede the fight

explanation.surface: Quitting a project, or conceding a boxing bout.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom comes from boxing, where it means to concede, and generally means to give up.

clue.text: Rower has changed familiar piece of music?

indicators.note: changed signals the letters are altered into another order

explanation.surface: A rower has swapped to a well-known tune.
explanation.definitionFit: A warhorse is an often-performed, well-worn piece of music.

clue.text: Element represented in middle of lunch?

definitions.text: Element represented in middle of lunch?

parts.words: Element represented in middle of lunch?
parts.note: the central letter of the word lunch is the chemical symbol of this gas

explanation.surface: Asks which ingredient is at the heart of a midday meal.
explanation.definitionFit: This gas has the chemical symbol N, the middle letter of lunch.

clue.text: Keg a crew mislaid? Sign of misfortune at sea

indicators.note: mislaid suggests letters put down in the wrong places

explanation.surface: A ship's crew lost a barrel, a sign of trouble at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Wreckage is the debris of a wrecked ship, evidence of disaster.

clue.text: European in revolutionary country outwardly has soft attitude

indicators.note: the European letter goes inside the revolutionary

parts.note: Lenin led the Russian revolution

indicators.note: only the first and last letters of the word are used

explanation.surface: A European in a rebel nation takes a gentle line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' looks like an adjective for the country, but it is the Russian leader; 'in' and 'outwardly' each act on their own piece, with 'has' as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Leniency is mildness or tolerance, a soft approach.

clue.text: Taxi rate unexpected for entertainment venue

parts.note: a cab is a taxi

indicators.note: unexpected signals the letters turn up in a surprising order

explanation.surface: The taxi fare was surprisingly high for a nightclub trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabaret is a nightclub or restaurant offering live entertainment.

clue.text: Tea permitted in small house

parts.note: cha is slang for tea
let means allowed or permitted

explanation.surface: Tea is allowed in a little cottage.
explanation.definitionFit: A chalet is a small wooden house or holiday cabin.

clue.text: Page almost revealing on-screen shape

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: buttons is an old word for a page boy, from the buttons on his uniform

explanation.surface: A page nearly shows a shape on a monitor.
explanation.walkthrough: BUTTONS is the traditional page boy in a British pantomime; 'almost' removes its final S.
explanation.definitionFit: A button is a clickable graphic on a computer screen.

clue.text: Make out record with English navy

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: Spot a recording made with an English naval band.
explanation.definitionFit: To discern is to perceive or detect something.

clue.text: Degeneration? Uninteresting nonsense

parts.note: dry means dull
rot is rubbish or nonsense

explanation.surface: A boring, meaningless talk about decline.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry rot is a fungal decay of timber, a kind of degeneration.

clue.text: One enjoying a virtual overview?

parts.note: someone who browses the internet, riding over the online world like a wave

explanation.surface: Describes someone taking a broad look at something not quite real.
explanation.definitionFit: A web user who browses widely is said to surf the internet.

clue.text: In which signs have to be studied?

definitions.text: In which signs have to be studied?

parts.words: In which signs have to be studied?
parts.note: signs suggests road signs or notices, but here they are zodiac signs

explanation.surface: Asks which test involves learning road signs.
explanation.definitionFit: Astrology is the study of the zodiac signs and their supposed influence.

clue.text: Stop some music

definitions.meaning: a repeated chorus in a song

explanation.surface: A command to halt a piece of music.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to desist as a verb and a recurring chorus as a noun.

clue.text: Colour retained by artist in general

indicators.note: the letters are held within the run of words

explanation.surface: A painter generally keeps a particular hue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retained by' points to the run inside 'artiST IN GEneral'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tinge is a slight trace of colour.

clue.text: Denial that is beginning to take in right-winger has public exposure

parts.note: no is a denial

indicators.note: the combined letters are placed inside the right-winger

parts.note: a Tory is a British Conservative
ie is the abbreviation for id est, that is

indicators.note: only the first letter of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: A refusal starting to involve a Conservative leads to scandal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beginning to' acts on 'take', while 'in' tucks the abbreviation and that letter into the right-winger.
explanation.definitionFit: Notoriety is fame for something bad, a damaging public exposure.
